About this item

  • Work or Home Phone - T613 is a dark grey cordless phone system with built in answering machine ideal for both office spaces and home use
  • Hands-Free Conversations - Cordless phone combo features hands-free speakerphone so you can take calls without a handset and multi-task while in meetings or talking with friends
  • Multiple Contact Phonebook - Telephone system holds up to 100 entries and includes convenient built-in answering machine to take messages when you're unavailable
  • Bright Lighted Display - Phone features caller ID, advanced call blocking to keep unwanted calls away, and easy-to-read backlit displays
  • Includes - Three (3) cordless handsets with base, six (6) rechargeable batteries, three (3) power adapters, setup guide

    About this Item

    • Work or Home Phone - T613 is a dark grey cordless phone system with built in answering machine ideal for both office spaces and home use
    • Hands-Free Conversations - Cordless phone combo features hands-free speakerphone so you can take calls without a handset and multi-task while in meetings or talking with friends
    • Multiple Contact Phonebook - Telephone system holds up to 100 entries and includes convenient built-in answering machine to take messages when you're unavailable
    • Bright Lighted Display - Phone features caller ID, advanced call blocking to keep unwanted calls away, and easy-to-read backlit displays
    • Includes - Three (3) cordless handsets with base, six (6) rechargeable batteries, three (3) power adapters, setup guide

    Product description

    The Motorola T6 Series Residential Cordless Phone Set with 3 Handsets is built to make communication easy, delivering a multitude of helpful features in an attractive and stylish design. With advance call blocking technology, you can easily screen and block calls you don’t want. With up to 12 minutes digital recording time, a large backlit display, and hands-free speakerphone, the Motorola T6 Series is the ideal choice for everyone!
